<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25a:13">Snh. 25ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>מפריחי יונים</he>, v. <cite ref="J00203"><he>יוֹנָה</he> II</cite>) <he>אי תקדמיה יוֹנָךְ ליון</he> if thy dove shall overtake the cock-pigeon (thou shalt win &c.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:6">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כמין יון וכ׳</he> they (the Samaritans) have an image resembling a cock-pigeon to which they offer libations (cmp. <cite ref="J00203"><he>יוֹנָה</he> II</cite>).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:9">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא יונה וכ׳</he> (masc.) a dove came down &c., v. <cite ref="I00860"><he>טְרַף</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>יוֹנִין</he>, <he>יוֹנַיָּא</he>, <he>יוֹנֵי</he>, <he>יוֹנָן</he>, <cite ref="J00211"><he>יוֹנָתָא</he></cite>.
